set.body: From the cold review of 97161f239. Presence rows follow input order. Hint arrays keep proposal order, so two hints between one class pair permute with the input. Duplicate proposal ids and several unparseable mention ids (all reported as empty) are stable-sorted and follow input order; duplicate proposal ids are not refused. The order court permutes neither presence nor more than one hint.
set.title: S3c-1 follow-up F3: make presence rows, hints and duplicate ids order independent (rule 10)
